newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: One-month to one-year Saudi t-bill rates rise.
newsitem.headline: One-month to one-year Saudi t-bill rates rise.

text.p: Yields climbed on one-month to one-year Saudi treasury bills worth two billion riyals offered by the Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency (SAMA) to local banks on Tuesday, bankers in Saudi Arabia said.
The yield on 28-day bills rose to 5.4850 percent from 5.3584 percent on last week's 35-day bills. The 91-day bills yielded 5.6108 percent from 5.5075 percent.

The rate on 182-day bills climbed to 5.7978 percent from 5.6509. The yield on 364-day paper rose to 6.1208 percent from 6.0077. They were priced at 99.57520, 98.60156, 97.15234 and 94.17188 respectively.
One-month interbank deposits were quoted at 5-5/8, 1/2 percent, three-month funds were at 5-3/4, 5/8 percent, six months were 5-15/16, 13/16 and one-year deposits were at 6-1/4, 1/8 percent.
